purpose: Drive one timed generation whose prompt length and requested output length are set by the caller, so speed can be measured without the model's answer mattering.

passage.description: Filler text sized to the prompt length under test. Its content is irrelevant to the measurement; only its token count is.

instruction.description: What to do with the passage, including the requested output length for the decode-throughput cases.

expectations: Any text. This prompt measures how fast tokens arrive, never whether they are correct.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.performance needs one prompt record so the reproducibility fingerprint has a real prompt subset hash from the first measured run.
